column1: # risk-tiers.tsv (harbor#1278) — the core default risk list: a sibling of controls.tsv, not a column of it, because a new column
# breaks every pack's byte-compare of its fragment (contracts/confinement-coverage.tsv says the same).
#   key    a control id from standards/naming/controls.tsv, unique
#   set    fixed | integrity | default (contracts/hub.md: what a hub may move)
#   label  the plain words a request shows, at most 60 characters
# A control with no row takes its default from its mode: block is very-high, warn is high. integrity is also derived from
# floor_shadow_enforces, so a row here only names its label.
